record.original_question: Let G contained in S_n and sigma = (sigma_1, ..., sigma_r) be as in the Hurwitz-space setup above, and let f: X -> P^1 be a cover of type sigma corresponding to a generic point of H(sigma) tensor F_p. What is the rank of the differential d phi_sigma at f, viewed as a map from the tangent space of H(sigma) at f to the tangent space of M_g at X?

Let f : X -> P1 be a cover of type sigma which corresponds to a generic point of H(sigma) tensor_Z Fp. Compute the rank of the map induced by phi_sigma on the tangent spaces at the point corresponding to f: d phi_sigma|f : T_H(sigma),f -> T_Mg,X.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $p$ be a prime, and let $G \subseteq S_n$ be a transitive subgroup. Fix an $r$-tuple $\sigma = (\sigma_1, \ldots, \sigma_r)$ of nontrivial conjugacy classes of $G$ satisfying the product-one condition (so that there is an associated Hurwitz space $H(\sigma)$ parametrizing isomorphism classes of Galois covers $f: X \to \mathbb{P}^1$ whose monodromy at the $r$ branch points has cycle types prescribed by $\sigma$). Let $H(\sigma)$ denote this Hurwitz space (over $\mathrm{Spec}\,\mathbb{Z}[1/|G|]$ or, more generally, the moduli stack of such covers), and let $M_g$ be the moduli stack of smooth projective curves of genus $g$, where $g$ is the genus of any cover of type $\sigma$ (determined by Riemann–Hurwitz). There is a natural forgetful morphism
$$\phi_\sigma: H(\sigma) \longrightarrow M_g, \qquad (f: X \to \mathbb{P}^1) \mapsto X.$$
Consider the base change $H(\sigma) \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} \mathbb{F}_p$, and let $f: X \to \mathbb{P}^1$ be a cover of type $\sigma$ corresponding to a generic geometric point of $H(\sigma) \otimes_{\mathbb{Z}} \mathbb{F}_p$.

Compute the rank of the induced linear map on tangent spaces
$$d\phi_\sigma|_f: T_{H(\sigma), f} \longrightarrow T_{M_g, X}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: A targeted web search did not turn up a published computation of the generic rank of the tangent map from a Hurwitz space to the moduli space of curves at a generic point in characteristic $p$. While the characteristic-zero situation (where $\phi_\sigma$ is unramified / has injective differential generically) is classical, the analogous question in positive characteristic does not appear to have a definitively recorded answer in the sources surfaced; status is therefore reported as unknown.

status_evidence.title: Hurwitz spaces (Romagny–Wewers survey)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of Hurwitz spaces and their morphisms to M_g; discusses smoothness and tangent space issues in mixed and positive characteristic without giving a closed formula for the generic rank of d phi_sigma in characteristic p.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit general formula for the rank of d phi_sigma at a generic point in characteristic p is recorded.

status_evidence.title: Hurwitz space - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: General reference on Hurwitz spaces and the map to M_g; characteristic-p behavior of the tangent map is not addressed.
status_evidence.claim: Standard references do not give the generic tangent rank in characteristic p.
